columns.name: id
columns.description: OpenStreetMap element id (n=node, w=way, r=relation) or slug; unique within kind.

columns.name: country
columns.description: ISO country code when the source gives it (DE, AT, CH, BE); null for records from the French source sites, which carry no country field.

columns.name: elevation_m
columns.description: Elevation in metres as tagged in OSM, null if untagged.

columns.name: ign_elevation_m
columns.description: Elevation from IGN RGE ALTI (Licence Ouverte 2.0), France only.

columns.name: prominence_m
columns.description: Topographic prominence in metres (OSM tag, rarely filled).

columns.name: local_relief_m
columns.description: Local relief within about 2 km in metres (computed by atlas-montagne from a DEM).

columns.name: isolation_km
columns.description: Distance to the nearest higher point in km (computed by atlas-montagne).

columns.name: isolation_ref
columns.description: Name of that nearest higher point.

columns.name: slope_deg
columns.description: Local slope in degrees (computed from a DEM).

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Viewing direction tag (viewpoints) or road direction tag (passes).

columns.name: climbs
columns.description: Road-climb sides of a pass: list of {side, length_km, ascent_m, grad_avg, grad_max, category} (atlas-montagne).

columns.name: profile_m
columns.description: Local topographic section: 48 elevation samples in metres (atlas-montagne, from a DEM).

columns.name: source_sites
columns.description: Source site(s) of the record, joined with +.
